description: List the saved revisions of a policy, newest first: revision number, when and by whom it was saved, and the policy version it produced. changedBy is recorded audit attribution, not proof of a manual human action. Read a saved configuration with get_policy_revision_document; saved versions do not prove a device applied them. Use rollback_policy only to propose a restore.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

limit.description: How many revisions to return, newest first (default 20).

policyId.description: The policy's path name - the unique identifier returned by list_policies as "pathName".

name: list_policy_revisions
title: List policy revisions
